title: When the Semester Wakes
premise: Casper Okafor, a scholarship student at Ashgrove Academy, has survived three years by being unremarkable—until her music theory teacher assigns her a semester-long composition project with Wren Castellan, the wealthy legacy student who got Casper's brother expelled two years ago. Forced into close collaboration, Casper discovers Wren's cruelty was a cover for a family secret tied to the scholarship fund that pays Casper's tuition, a fund built on money the Castellans took from Casper's own family. As the final audition approaches, Casper must choose between exposing the truth and losing Wren, the first person who ever saw her clearly—ending with Casper telling the whole story on stage, keeping a bruised but honest friendship and forfeiting the scholarship she came to protect.
about_author: Edmund Joubert is the pen name of a former boarding school music teacher who spent a decade watching brilliant students hide in plain sight. He writes young adult fiction about the families we build when the ones we inherited fail us, and lives near a lake that freezes too early.

chapters.title: Assigned Seats
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. On the first day of senior year, Ms. Iyer pairs Casper with Wren Castellan for a semester composition project worth their entire grade, and Wren's smirk promises the old cruelty hasn't faded. Casper's careful rules—no opinions, no history, no eye contact—begin cracking the moment Wren hums a melody their late mother used to play. Emotional beat: dread laced with an unwanted flicker of recognition.

chapters.title: The Practice Room Tapes
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Working nights in a soundproof practice room, the two find a fragile rhythm until Casper finds old reel-to-reel tapes in the music archive labeled with her family's name—and Wren's father's. Wren confesses her father engineered the scholarship fund's takeover and framed Casper's brother to keep him quiet. Emotional beat: the vertigo of learning your enemy is also your witness.

chapters.title: Everything We Were Careful With
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Casper tests the evidence against the board, but Wren panics—exposure means losing her inheritance, her name, everything her mother left her—and betrays Casper's draft to Ms. Iyer as plagiarism, echoing how Casper's brother fell. The friendship detonates days before the audition. Emotional beat: betrayal as inheritance repeating itself, and Casper's rage hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Final Audition
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. At the winter showcase, instead of the safe commissioned piece, Casper performs the composition she and Wren built from the tapes—telling the whole story from the stage while the board listens. The scholarship is revoked, but the fund's fraud surfaces, Wren publicly corroborates her, and the two leave the hall not as friends exactly, but as family of a harder, truer kind. Emotional beat: grief and freedom arriving in the same breath.
